name: call_pixel_plot_with_state
description: Calls the pixel plotting routine once, passing the shared state block as its argument, and returns. It has no other effect.

name: walk_zigzag_grid_cells
description: Visits the cells of a three-row grid whose row lengths come from a shared table, reversing the sign of the step on each row. Each cell makes eight calls to a called routine and advances two shared coordinate words by the step, and the routine ends with a fixed run of calls and a minus-two correction to both words.

name: load_table_pair_into_words
description: Reads a word from a shared table at an index passed in a register and stores it, plus 90, in one shared word. It then reads a second word from a fixed table, stores it, and stores that value plus 16 in a further word before calling the next routine.

name: poll_flag_with_timeout
description: Multiplies the count passed in a register by 300 and counts it down while polling a shared flag byte. When the flag's top bit is set it clears that bit and returns, otherwise it returns the leftover count when the countdown runs out.

name: copy_bitplane_rectangle_rows
description: Copies a rectangle of four bitplane bytes row by row between two screen buffers, with a 40-byte row stride and 8000-byte spacing between planes. A conditional branch on a bit of the shared state byte may also modify that state during the copy.

name: fill_bitplane_rectangle
description: Writes the shared state byte into four bitplanes across a rectangle, with 8000-byte plane spacing and a 40-byte row stride, moving to the next row when the column count ends. It also reads one source byte per cell and conditionally clears a shared word, mirroring the copy routine.

name: relay_register_pair_via_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns the two 32-bit register values it was given, unchanged. It adds no logic of its own.

name: relay_register_pair_via_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns the two 32-bit register values it was given, unchanged. It adds no logic of its own.

name: blit_bitmap_and_wait_frame
description: Calls the graphics library bitmap blitter, then waits for the next video frame to finish.

name: blit_bitmap_and_wait_frame
description: Calls the graphics library bitmap blitter, then waits for the next video frame to finish.

name: blit_bitmap_and_wait_frame
description: Calls the graphics library bitmap blitter, then waits for the next video frame to finish.

name: run_circular_table_sequencer
description: Sets two index words and two byte fields of an object, then walks a 512-byte circular table. Entries of 255 are skipped and other entries are used as indices back into the table, with a repeat count that drives four calls per step; the exit path saves the current index, though its decompiled condition is a constant.

name: run_title_table_sequencer
description: Sets the same object fields as its neighbouring routine and then runs the same circular table loop. The referenced strings are PRESS <SPACE> and ULTIMA III.

name: call_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Invokes three routines one after another, with no arguments or results of its own.

name: render_tile_map_to_planes
description: Adjusts 121 bytes of a shared buffer, changing values in one narrow range when a flag bit is set, then copies 64-byte table entries selected by those bytes into four bitplane buffers as 2-byte columns. The copy runs 18 cells per band over 5 bands and waits for a frame at the end.

name: copy_table_block_to_planes
description: Calls a routine to obtain an index, selects the 64-byte block of a shared table at that index, and writes its 16 words into four bitplane buffers with a 40-byte row spacing, starting at a fixed offset.

name: play_sample_on_channel_three
description: Starts a sound on audio channel 3 when the shared enable bit is set, choosing sample pointer, length, period and volume from the sound number in a register. It disables DMA, reprograms the channel and interrupt registers, re-enables them, then streams a table of words into the channel until a zero entry.

name: store_word_then_busy_wait
description: Stores the value passed in a register into a fixed field of an object, then spins in a nested countdown loop as a delay before returning.

name: toggle_custom_chip_reset_phase
description: Flips bit 0 of a shared state byte on each call and writes a set of control words to the custom chip registers, using one pattern on one phase and a different pattern on the other.

name: reset_custom_chip_control_words
description: Writes fixed control values to three custom chip registers relative to a base pointer, resetting audio-related DMA and interrupt state.

name: install_vector10_and_copy_table
description: Installs an interrupt handler on vector 10, clears three state words and copies a table of bytes from a fixed address into a word array. It finishes by setting bit 0 of a state word.

name: call_routine_sixteen_times
description: Calls one routine sixteen times in a row and returns.

name: silence_audio_channels_and_init
description: Points audio channels 0 to 2 at a shared buffer, sets their lengths to 128 and their volumes to zero, then stores 63 in a shared volume word.

name: call_routine_when_flag_set
description: Tests the top bit of a shared state byte and calls one routine only when that bit is set.

name: advance_sound_sequencer_voices
description: Steps the per-voice state for the sound channels, updating period and volume values from stored step data and writing them to the channel registers when DMA is enabled. Command bytes read from a sequence stream drive the note and effect handling; the bundle truncates this decompiled code partway, so the later command cases are not visible.

name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Returns the byte at a stream pointer held in a shared word, then advances that pointer by one.

name: find_matching_slot_index
description: Searches a nine-entry shared array from the last entry backwards for one that matches two bytes of the object passed in a register. It returns the matching index, or 255 when none matches.

name: step_position_until_bounds
description: Adds per-step deltas to two coordinate bytes of an object while both stay below 11. At each step it writes two bytes into an output buffer, and it returns the result of a called routine or 255 once the coordinates leave the range.

name: set_unit_step_from_command
description: Reads command bytes until one matches a unit-step code, sets the object's step deltas to that unit step, and adds the deltas to its coordinate bytes. Each of the four codes maps to a different unit direction.

name: apply_unit_step_from_stream
description: Reads command bytes until one matches a unit-step code, sets the object's step deltas to that unit step, and adds the deltas to its coordinate bytes. Each of the four codes maps to a different unit direction.

name: advance_position_by_step
description: Adds the object's two step deltas to its two coordinate bytes, with no bounds check.

name: classify_sign_of_byte
description: Returns 0 for a zero byte passed in a register, 1 for a positive byte, and 255 for a negative byte.

name: classify_sign_of_shifted_byte
description: Returns 0 when the byte passed in a register, shifted left by two bits, is zero, 1 when that result is positive, and 255 when it is negative.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns; the routine body is a bare return with no instructions of its own.

name: lookup_grid_cell_table_byte
description: Multiplies one object byte by 11, adds a second object byte to the low byte of the product, and returns the shared table byte at that offset.

name: validate_input_for_state_byte
description: Checks a state byte of the object: when it lies between 22 and 31 only an input of zero is accepted, otherwise only the codes 2, 4, 6 or 16 are accepted. It returns 0 for an accepted input and 255 for a rejected one.

name: accept_code_and_run_action
description: Returns 255 unless the input code is 2, 4, 6 or 16; for those codes it calls one routine and returns 0.

name: scan_candidate_moves_for_fit
description: Loops over candidate positions up to a count stored in the object, computing differences between shared table values and the object's coordinates. It keeps the first candidate whose two offsets each fall within a small range and saves its coordinates and step into the object's record.

name: reset_scan_index_from_saved
description: Copies a saved index byte in the object back into the current scan index byte.

name: map_sign_code_to_punctuation
description: Calls one routine, then maps a signed code byte from the object to one of several punctuation character codes, returning a default code when none matches.

name: map_code_field_to_punctuation
description: Maps a signed code byte stored in the object to one of several punctuation character codes, returning a default code when none matches.

name: run_entity_update_and_commands
description: Initialises an object's fields and a 32-entry flag table, then loops over the object's entries, updating coordinates and timing counts and decoding command bytes from a stream. The bundle truncates the decompiled body, so the later command cases are not visible.

name: run_entity_update_loop
description: Repeats the per-entry update and command decoding loop of its neighbouring routine without the initial setup, until the entry count is exhausted. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: decode_entity_command_stream
description: Decodes command bytes from a stream for an object: some codes change its position or facing index, some branch to case handlers, and others are skipped. The loop ends when the entry count is exhausted, and the bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: xor_checksum_into_state_bytes
description: Reads a 32-bit value, stores it in an object field, then XORs its four bytes into eight shared state bytes at fixed locations, returning zero.

name: call_routine_once
description: Calls one routine and returns without any other effect.

name: walk_string_advancing_column
description: Walks a zero-terminated string and calls one routine for each byte. Bytes equal to 255 leave the object's column unchanged, while other bytes increment that column by one.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines one after another and returns.

name: write_masked_block_to_planes
description: Computes a screen byte offset from two object coordinates with a 320-byte row stride, then writes eight bytes from a table entry, masked by a shared mask byte, into four bitplanes at a 40-byte row stride.

name: write_table_block_to_plane
description: Computes a screen byte offset from two object coordinates with a 320-byte row stride, then copies eight bytes from a table entry into a single bitplane at a 40-byte row stride.

name: call_routine_per_string_byte
description: Calls one routine once, then calls it again for every byte of a zero-terminated string addressed by a register, and returns zero.

name: call_routine_then_reset_offsets
description: Calls one routine and then sets two coordinate fields of the object to 24.

name: call_string_routine_then_advance
description: Calls a routine with a shared data address, then calls a second routine and increments an object field. The selection assigns the same address in both branches, so the choice has no effect.

name: copy_row_block_to_planes
description: Copies an eight-row block of bytes across four bitplanes from a source buffer to the destination, with a 40-byte row stride.

name: call_nine_steps_set_mask
description: Calls one routine, then calls another nine times, then calls a third and writes a fixed mask word to a shared location.

name: invoke_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two routines in turn and returns.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns without any other effect.

name: clear_bitplane_rows
description: Zeroes 176 rows across four bitplanes, clearing 22 bytes per row at a 40-byte row stride starting from a fixed offset.

name: invoke_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without any other effect.

name: clear_bitmap_with_blitter
description: Calls the graphics library bitmap clear routine to clear 32000 bytes of the bitmap referenced by an object field.

name: invert_rows_at_table_offset
description: Looks up a column offset in a table indexed by an object field, calls routines chosen by a mode field, then complements one byte in each of eight rows at a 40-byte stride from that offset.

name: invert_eight_rows_at_offset
description: Complements one byte in each of eight rows at a 40-byte stride, starting at an offset passed in a register.

name: dispatch_on_mode_byte
description: Calls one routine, then calls either a second routine with its result or a third routine that supplies the result, depending on whether a mode byte in the object equals 1, and finally calls a fourth routine.

name: dispatch_on_mode_byte
description: Performs the same mode-dependent call sequence as its neighbouring routine, calling a routine on either branch and returning the value of the first call.

name: pass_through_routine_result
description: Calls one routine and returns the register pair it leaves, with no other logic.

name: call_routine_then_advance_column
description: Calls one routine and then increments the object's column field by one.

name: call_twice_then_advance_column
description: Calls one routine twice and then increments the object's column field by one.

name: call_routine_then_advance_column
description: Calls one routine and then increments the object's column field by one.

name: scale_index_to_offset
description: Returns the register value shifted left by six bits, which converts an index into the byte offset of a 64-byte table entry.

name: clear_buffer_then_copy_rows
description: Zeroes a shared buffer of 64 32-bit entries, then repeatedly copies 16-byte groups from a source to a destination while a called routine reports a nonzero remaining count.

name: copy_sixteen_byte_groups
description: Copies 16-byte groups from a source to a destination, one group per pass, as directed by a called routine, until that routine reports no remaining groups.

name: layout_encoded_text_line
description: Reads encoded text codes from a stream and lays out a line: code 141 ends the line and stores its width and offset fields, code 136 moves the column back by one, and codes in a small range start a run of characters.

name: layout_encoded_text_from_code
description: Decodes a line of encoded text codes starting from a code passed in a register, moving the column for the back-step code and recording the line width when the end code is reached.

name: layout_encoded_text_continue
description: Continues the encoded text layout loop from a mid-point entry, handling the same codes and storing the line width and offset on the end code.

name: compute_line_width_fields
description: Adds ten for each unit of a count field to produce an offset and stores it with a base value in one object field, then stores the base value plus sixteen times the count in another.

name: reduce_value_modulo_field
description: Stores its input in an object field, then reduces a value returned by a called routine by repeatedly subtracting that field until the result is smaller, and stores the remainder in the field.

name: call_six_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls six routines one after another and returns.

name: tick_two_countdowns_and_call
description: Decrements two countdown bytes in the object; each countdown that reaches zero is reloaded to 2 and triggers a routine call, and a routine is also called after each decrement.

name: call_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three routines one after another and returns.

name: tick_countdown_with_reload
description: Decrements a countdown byte in the object and, when it reaches zero, reloads it to 3 and calls a routine.

name: tick_countdown_reload_two
description: Decrements a countdown byte in the object and, when it reaches zero, reloads it to 2 and calls a routine.

name: tick_countdown_then_call_two
description: Decrements a countdown byte in the object; when it reaches zero it reloads it to 1 and calls two routines.

name: swap_masked_bits_between_rows
description: When a flag in the object is set, exchanges masked bits between pairs of words in four rows spaced 32 bytes apart, using two mask words taken from a table indexed by the input.

name: rotate_words_left_one_bit
description: Calls one routine, then rotates eight 16-bit words in the bitplane data left by one bit each, taken from fixed offsets.

name: rotate_record_words_left
description: Rotates eight 16-bit words stored in the object's record left by one bit each, in two groups of four words spaced 32 bytes apart.

name: decrement_packed_counter_bytes
description: Decrements the low seven bits of 121 shared bytes. When one underflows it takes a low-nibble value from a called routine and inverts the high bit.

name: set_origin_then_walk_string
description: Stores two input values as the object's column and row, then walks a zero-terminated string and calls one routine per byte. Bytes equal to 255 leave the column unchanged, and other bytes advance it by one.

name: return_index_as_offset
description: Returns the object's index byte shifted left by six bits, giving the byte offset of a 64-byte table entry.

name: center_string_from_index_row
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, sets the starting column to 31 minus half its length and the row from an index, then calls one routine for each byte, advancing the column by one per character.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns; the decoded bytes are a bare return with no instructions of its own.

name: lookup_tile_byte_from_position
description: Copies the object's two coordinate bytes into its working fields, then returns the shared table byte at an index formed from the first coordinate plus 64 times the second.

name: lookup_tile_byte_at_position
description: Returns the shared table byte at an index formed from the object's working column plus 64 times its working row.

name: reset_counter_and_pick_value
description: Decrements a countdown byte; when it goes negative it resets the countdown to 8 and picks a new value from a called routine, reducing it by 4 until it is below 5 and different from a stored value. It then sets two coordinate fields, calls a routine three times, and restores the first field.

name: check_slot_match_and_state
description: Returns 255 when the input byte matches a stored byte of the object, or that byte is zero, and the object's state byte equals 22; otherwise it returns zero.

name: add_bytes_into_counter
description: Adds a shared byte into a 15-byte counter with carry propagating from the highest index down, then increments the final byte with carry propagation.

name: add_decimal_digits_bcd
description: Adds an object byte into a four-byte decimal counter, applying decimal correction to the sum and then to each higher byte in turn.

name: wait_until_subroutine_flag
description: Stores two input bytes in object fields, then calls routines in a loop until a flag from one of them is set, returning the last value obtained.

name: shift_history_queue_on_countdown
description: Decrements a shared counter and, when it reaches zero, resets it to the dash character and rotates an eight-byte shared array by one place.

name: build_and_render_tile_grid
description: Fills a 10 by 10 grid of cells in a shared buffer by propagating values from neighbouring cells, then adjusts values in a narrow range and renders the cells as 64-byte table entries into four bitplanes, as its neighbour does.

name: render_small_tile_map
description: Copies 64-byte table entries selected by a 10 by 10 grid of bytes into four bitplane buffers as 2-byte columns, 10 cells per band over 10 bands, starting at a fixed offset.

name: adjust_and_render_tile_map
description: Adjusts values in a narrow range across 121 shared bytes, then copies 64-byte table entries selected by a 10 by 10 grid into four bitplanes as 2-byte columns, 10 cells per band.

name: read_table_pointer_byte
description: Looks up a pointer in a table indexed by the input and returns the byte it points to, combined with the high byte of the scaled index.

name: tick_frame_counter_and_wait
description: Decrements a shared frame counter while it is nonzero, calls a routine when it reaches zero, then calls two routines and waits for the next video frame.

name: rotate_word_rows_right
description: Shifts four rows of sixteen words in a shared table one place along, moving the last word of each row to the front.

name: call_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three routines one after another and returns.

name: read_joystick_port_state
description: Reads the controller port register and the potentiometer register, decodes direction and button bits into a state value, and copies the stored controller state into working fields. The bundle truncates the decompiled body partway.

name: lookup_shared_byte_by_index
description: Returns the byte of a shared table at the index passed in a register. The facts list a controller port register, but the visible code only performs this lookup.

name: arm_flag_and_call_routine
description: When a shared flag byte is zero, sets it to minus one and calls one routine; otherwise it does nothing.

name: clear_flag_and_call_routine
description: When a shared flag byte is nonzero, clears it and calls one routine.

name: test_point_in_rect_passthrough
description: Tests whether a point lies inside a rectangle stored in a structure, but both outcomes return the input byte unchanged, so the test has no visible effect.

name: test_point_in_rect
description: Tests whether a point lies inside a rectangle stored in a structure and returns without changing any value, so the test has no visible effect.

name: update_cell_index_cache
description: Returns early when the requested position matches the cached position. Otherwise it converts the point into a grid cell index in bands of 16 and stores the new cached index and status.

name: reset_cell_cache_and_refresh
description: Stores a sentinel value in a shared word, calls a routine, and calls one more routine when the mode byte equals 1.

name: map_point_to_cell_value
description: Converts two input coordinates into a grid cell index in bands of 16, returns early if it matches the last index, and otherwise looks up a value for that index in a table and calls one routine.

name: set_mode_five_and_call
description: When a shared byte is not 5, sets it to 5 and calls one routine.

name: invoke_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without any other effect.

name: invoke_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without any other effect.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decompiles to a single call and a return, although the routine counts 160 instructions. The rest of the body is not shown, so this output is incomplete rather than a description of behaviour.

name: invoke_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without any other effect.

name: build_jump_stub_table
description: Fills 20 entries of a shared buffer, each a jump instruction followed by a 32-bit target copied from a table of addresses.

name: clear_bit7_wait_ready
description: Clears bit 7 of a shared control longword, then repeatedly calls a routine with a timeout argument until it returns a value other than minus one and a shared flag is nonzero, returning the input value.

name: clear_bit7_wait_second_timeout
description: Clears bit 7 of the same shared control longword, then repeats the routine call with a different timeout argument until the ready condition holds, returning the input value.

name: save_position_call_restore
description: Saves the object's two coordinate bytes and a shared longword, calls one routine, then restores those values.

name: update_entity_with_poll_timeout
description: Clears two state bytes of the object, sets its working position from its stored coordinates, and runs a bounded polling loop that counts down from 114750 while reading an input value and calling routines. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: decode_entity_commands_with_poll
description: Runs the same bounded polling update as its neighbour, then decodes the command byte read from the stream: code 129 changes the entity's facing and other codes drive further routine calls. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: step_entity_timer_and_state
description: Decrements a timer byte in the object while it is nonzero, reads a state value, and when that state equals 1 clears a byte, runs a sequence of routine calls and sets a shared state to 4. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: step_entity_timer_and_state
description: Decrements a timer byte in the object while it is nonzero, reads a state value, and when that state equals 1 clears a byte, runs a sequence of routine calls and sets a shared state to 4. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: step_entity_timer_and_state
description: Decrements a timer byte in the object while it is nonzero, reads a state value, and when that state equals 1 clears a byte, runs a sequence of routine calls and sets a shared state to 4. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: count_flagged_bytes_then_step
description: Reads a stream byte at the object's position and, when bit 5 is set, increments a counter in the object, then runs the shared timer and state step.

name: decrement_counter_then_step
description: Reads a stream byte at the object's position; when bit 4 is set it decrements a counter in the object and stops if that counter goes negative, otherwise it runs the shared timer and state step.

name: initialise_entity_from_template
description: Copies two template bytes into the object's coordinate fields, clears a flag and a state byte, calls a series of routines, and reads command bytes that set the object's state.

name: dispatch_entity_state_codes
description: Decrements a decimal countdown in the object and dispatches on its state code, branching into the shared timer and state step. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: decrement_decimal_countdown_then_step
description: Decrements a decimal countdown in the object when it is nonzero, then runs the shared timer and state step.

name: set_decimal_countdown_and_step
description: Stores a decimal-adjusted value from a register in the object's countdown field, sets two shared state values, and runs the shared timer and state step.

name: set_state_and_run_step
description: Sets two shared state values and runs the shared timer and state step.

name: run_entity_state_dispatch
description: Runs the shared timer and state step and dispatches on its result: code 1 clears a byte and runs a sequence of routine calls, while code 2 runs a further sequence.

name: dispatch_on_input_code
description: Dispatches on a code passed in a register: code 1 clears a byte and runs a fixed sequence of routine calls, and code 2 runs a loop that resets two coordinate fields and calls routines. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: run_entity_step_with_poll
description: Runs a fixed sequence of routine calls, then the bounded polling update used by its neighbours. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: copy_state_and_poll_loop
description: Repeatedly copies two stored bytes into the object's record and runs the bounded polling update, looping while a state value remains nonzero. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: run_entity_poll_with_calls
description: Runs a fixed group of nine routine calls and then a bounded polling update inside a loop. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: run_entity_poll_update_loop
description: Runs a fixed group of routine calls and then a bounded polling update of the object's state, repeating while a state byte is nonzero. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: compute_single_bit_mask
description: Returns a one-bit mask: the value 1 shifted left by the count passed in a register.

name: lookup_table_pair_by_bytes
description: Returns a 16-bit value combining an object byte with a shared table byte selected by that byte and the object's coordinates.

name: xor_scramble_buffer_with_key
description: XORs 2048 bytes of a shared buffer with a rotating four-byte key taken from object fields, processing four bytes per step.

name: wait_until_shared_byte_clears
description: Clears a shared byte and then spins while that byte remains nonzero.

name: store_byte_to_shared_slot
description: Stores the byte passed in a register into a shared byte location, twice.

name: repeat_call_while_result_one
description: Calls two routines, then keeps calling one routine while it returns the value one before finishing.

name: run_state_machine_until_result
description: Runs a small state machine that polls a state word and returns 1 when the state word equals 1, leaves its inner loop when it equals 2, and returns 3 after a flagged branch.

name: init_state_bits_run_machine
description: Sets bits 0, 1 and 2 of a shared state byte, calling routines when each bit was previously clear, then runs a state loop that waits for a state word to equal 2 and handles state 1 with a further call.

name: xor_shared_byte_with_field
description: XORs a shared byte with an object field and clears a state word. The decompiled output shows only these operations, although the routine has 148 instructions and calls 13 routines, so the body is incomplete.

name: store_decremented_index_and_call
description: Stores the register input minus one in a shared word and calls one routine.

name: initialise_object_defaults
description: Sets several object fields to default values (a flag of 0, and 126, 255, 44 and 20), calls one routine when a count field is nonzero, and sets a shared state word to 1.

name: run_state_three_until_done
description: Stores an input in a shared word, sets a state value to 3, calls three routines, waits until a state word reads 2, and returns that state value.

name: wait_until_state_ready
description: Repeatedly calls a routine until a shared state word equals 2, then returns that state word.

name: draw_list_rows_empty_text
description: Loops over rows whose index wraps within a fixed range, calling routines to draw each row and to write a fill value. The referenced text is '- Empty -'.

name: run_selection_state_loop
description: Runs a large nested loop over a 16-value selection variable, updating table pointers and calling routines for each state. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: draw_title_and_mark_entry
description: Calls routines to draw the referenced title line '-Create Character-' after a short delay loop, then stores a value with its top bit set in a table at the input offset.

name: set_fixed_cursor_and_call
description: Calls one routine, sets the object's column and row to 17 and 9, and calls another routine.

name: call_routine_per_string_byte
description: Calls one routine once, then calls it again for every byte of a zero-terminated string addressed by a register, and returns zero.

name: call_routine_per_string_byte
description: Calls one routine for each byte of a zero-terminated string addressed by a register, and returns zero.

name: draw_four_menu_rows
description: Calls routines to draw four consecutive lines at column 14, starting at row 1 and advancing the row each time, then calls two more routines.

name: find_char_then_call
description: Searches a string for the byte passed in a register and then calls a routine with the result. When that byte is zero it instead calls one routine for each byte of a fixed string and returns zero; the referenced text includes '-Create Character-' and 'Select'.

name: skip_to_char_then_call
description: Advances through a string until it reaches the byte passed in a register, then calls one routine.

name: edit_text_input_line
description: Handles one key code for a text entry line: code 141 ends entry, code 136 deletes the previous character and moves the column back, and codes from 190 to 218 are stored in the text buffer and advance the column.

name: call_routine_then_advance_column
description: Calls one routine and then increments the object's column field by one.

name: scale_low_byte_to_offset
description: Returns the low byte of the input shifted left by six bits, converting an index into a 64-byte table offset.

name: copy_sixteen_bytes
description: Copies sixteen bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer, advancing both.

name: select_slot_and_wait
description: Selects one of two shared slots depending on whether the input index is below seven, stores index-based offsets in two words, sets a state value to 5, calls routines, waits until a state word reads 2, then restores the previous state.

name: poll_joystick_menu_input
description: Walks a linked list of on-screen hit regions and reads the controller port register to decide whether a selection changed. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: arm_flag_and_call_routine
description: When a shared flag byte is zero, sets it to minus one and calls one routine; otherwise it does nothing.

name: clear_flag_and_call_routine
description: When a shared flag byte is nonzero, clears it and calls one routine.

name: set_bounds_box_and_call
description: Stores a pair of corner positions derived from the first two stored bytes with one added, and from the next two bytes with one subtracted, then calls one routine.

name: set_bounds_box_and_call
description: Stores a pair of corner positions derived from the first two stored bytes with one added, and from the next two bytes with one subtracted, then calls one routine.

name: process_entry_list_for_selection
description: Loads a word from a table entry chosen by the current index, calls a routine, then walks a zero-terminated list of pointers, calling a routine for each entry that is not the sentinel minus one.

name: dispatch_on_two_flag_bits
description: Calls one routine when bit 1 of the input is set, and calls five routines in sequence when bit 0 is set.

name: shift_offsets_by_delta
description: Adds an input delta to some shared position words and subtracts it from others, then stores the first combined word in a further shared word.

name: run_menu_entry_table
description: Walks a table of six-byte menu entries: type 1 returns one and type 3 returns three, while other entries set the object's column, row and a longword and draw a string through a routine. The referenced title is '-Create Character-'.

name: skip_n_strings
description: Advances a string pointer past a count of zero-terminated strings given in a register.

name: set_corner_pair_and_call
description: Copies two words from a source structure into shared corner words, then calls one routine.

name: call_routines_then_repeat_four
description: Calls three routines, then calls one routine four times.

name: call_routine_then_four_times
description: Calls one routine, then calls another routine four times.

name: copy_bounds_words_from_source
description: Copies nine words from a source structure into shared corner and position words.

name: draw_line_to_coordinates
description: Calls the graphics library routine that draws a line to the point given by the two register values.

name: move_pen_to_coordinates
description: Calls the graphics library routine that moves the drawing position to the point given by the two register values.

name: set_drawing_pen
description: Calls the graphics library routine that sets the drawing pen colour of the shared rastport.

name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the end of a buffer with a called routine, then copies a zero-terminated string onto it including its terminator, and returns the buffer address.

name: copy_string_bounded_to_buffer
description: Finds the end of a buffer with a called routine, then copies up to a given count of characters from a string, stopping at zero and adding a terminator.

name: format_string_into_buffer
description: Walks a format string, copying ordinary characters into a buffer; a doubled percent sign writes one percent sign, and other percent sequences are passed to a called routine with the argument. The bundle truncates the decompiled body.

name: start_disk_track_read
description: Prepares a disk read request: copies a 20-byte template into a request block, selects a drive by bit, stores a length argument, disables interrupts, sets the disk sync pattern and enables the disk controller, then returns a status word.

name: combine_drive_status_bits
description: Combines a status byte with the inverted values of two bytes from a request block, forcing bit 7 on in the status.

name: set_drive_control_bits
description: Sets bits 3 to 6 of a shared control byte and leaves the other bits alone.

name: delay_by_quarter_count
description: Calls a routine a quarter of the number passed in a register times, as a timing delay.

name: set_flag_then_delay_once
description: Returns zero if a status byte in the request is already set; otherwise it sets the byte, calls two routines, runs a 500000-count delay and returns that result.

name: set_flag_and_delay
description: Sets a status byte in a request block, calls two routines, and runs a 500000-count delay.

name: set_control_bit0_and_delay
description: Sets bit 0 of a control byte and runs a delay of 3000 counts.

name: step_drive_and_wait_ready
description: Clears a request word, sets a control bit and polls a status bit until it clears, then sets another control bit and polls until it sets, and finally runs a 15000-count delay.

name: set_control_bit1_and_wait
description: Sets bit 1 of a control byte, waits while the status bit remains set, then runs a 15000-count delay.

name: delay_15000_then_call
description: Runs a 15000-count delay and then calls one routine with a value from the request block.

name: seek_to_track_position
description: Moves a stored position toward a target value: it sets direction bits, steps the difference one unit at a time with short delays, and returns zero when already at the target.

name: seek_stored_track_pair
description: Checks two stored position values in a request block and steps them toward their targets, setting direction bits and waiting briefly between steps.
